 Ward 3 race decided by single vote
 1 hour, 9 minutes ago 
 by 
 Marc Hayot
 -->
 -->
 -->
 -->
 After all the votes -- including overseas, absentee and provisional -- were counted, Mark Long is the winner of Seat 3 on the Siloam Springs Board of Directors.
 Final results had Long with 526 votes (50.05%) and Kevin Williams with 525 votes (49.95%). The Benton County Election Commission certified the Nov. 3 results Nov. 13.
